title: Super Mega Pinball 7800
blurb: A pinball table with real flipper physics, a wire ramp, drop targets and three-ball multiball, with music on two POKEY chips.

title: Atari Gamma Force
blurb: A vertical shooter in nine stages, with the Vulcan, the Radiant Sword that absorbs pink bullets, and bosses taken apart piece by piece.

title: Astro Wing: Starfighter
blurb: A multi-directional space shooter with Newtonian physics: six sectors, drifting asteroids, ship upgrades and a flagship at the end.

title: Spacewar 7800
blurb: Bill Seiler's 1985 Spacewar for the 7800: a duel around a sun with real gravity, against the computer or a friend.
